verdict.rationale: Convex documents its own automation primitives. These include crons (time-based triggers), a scheduler for running background workflows, and httpAction endpoints that can run code when an inbound HTTP request arrives. That gives time-based and request-based automatic execution, but the evidence never shows declarative event rules such as running an action automatically when a database document changes. missing for 10: documented data-change/event triggers, a rule-definition model (declarative or AI-assisted), detail on how the scheduler is wired to events, independent corroboration
